West Bengal launches new cash assistance scheme for women

West Bengal has launched the Annapurna Yojana, a new scheme providing ₹3,000 per month to women beneficiaries. The scheme will run alongside the existing Lakshmir Bhandar scheme during its implementation phase. Reports indicate that approximately 26 lakh applications were rejected due to citizenship concerns.
